assets.title: Asset Register
assets.description: Inventory of all IT and OT systems supporting essential services. Required by CIR 2024/2690 §12 and NIS2 Art. 21(2)(i).
assets.helpText: Register every IT system, OT device, cloud service, and physical asset your organization relies on. Mark critical assets and OT systems separately - these face stricter NIS2 requirements.
assets.empty: No assets yet. Add your first asset to get started.
assets.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this asset?

fieldDescriptions.name: Unique name identifying this asset in your organization's inventory.
fieldDescriptions.type: Category of asset per NIS2 all-hazards scope.
fieldDescriptions.description: Brief description of the asset's purpose and role in supporting essential services.
fieldDescriptions.status: Select the current operational status of this asset.
fieldDescriptions.isOT: Enable if this is an Operational Technology asset (SCADA, ICS, PLC). OT assets face stricter NIS2 requirements.
fieldDescriptions.isCritical: Enable if this asset directly supports essential or important services under NIS2 scope.
fieldDescriptions.owner: Person or role responsible for managing and maintaining this asset (CIR 2024/2690 Recital).
fieldDescriptions.location: Physical or logical location where the asset is deployed (e.g., data center, cloud region, office).
fieldDescriptions.ipAddress: Primary IP address assigned to this asset.
fieldDescriptions.hostname: Fully qualified hostname or DNS name of this asset.
fieldDescriptions.operatingSystem: Operating system and major version (e.g., Ubuntu 22.04, Windows Server 2022).
fieldDescriptions.softwareVersion: Primary application or firmware version installed on this asset.
fieldDescriptions.accessManagement: How access to this asset is managed, e.g. AD group, SSO, local accounts (CIR 2024/2690 point 11.2).
fieldDescriptions.privilegedAccountCount: Number of accounts with administrative privileges on this asset (CIR 2024/2690 point 11.3).
fieldDescriptions.hasMfa: Whether multi-factor authentication is enforced for access to this asset.
fieldDescriptions.encryptionAtRest: Approved algorithm from cryptography policy applied to data at rest (e.g., AES-256-GCM).
fieldDescriptions.encryptionInTransit: Approved TLS suite from cryptography policy applied to data in transit (e.g., TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384).
fieldDescriptions.cryptoImplementation: Tool or hardware implementing encryption (e.g., BitLocker + TPM, AWS KMS, Let's Encrypt).
fieldDescriptions.hasBackup: Whether regular backups are configured and running for this asset.
fieldDescriptions.lastPatchDate: Date when the most recent security patch was applied (CIR 2024/2690 Recital).
fieldDescriptions.lastVulnScanDate: Date when the last vulnerability scan was performed.
fieldDescriptions.lastBackupTestDate: Date when the last backup restoration test was completed.
fieldDescriptions.endOfLife: Date when this asset reaches end of life / end of support (CIR 2024/2690 Recital).
fieldDescriptions.quantity: Number of identical units in this asset group (BSI-200-2 §8.1 grouping).
fieldDescriptions.processesPersonalData: Enable if this asset stores, processes, or transmits personal data (triggers GDPR considerations and feeds the RoPA inventory).
